objective: Replace the slow cross-database eligibility join with a self-contained OSL price snapshot while preserving rolling-feature warm-up history.
algorithm: Read both inputs in ticker-date order and merge matching keys once in bounded batches; reject unmatched keys, duplicates, changed inputs, and cutoff violations.
source_policy: Open both input databases read-only and never copy holdout rows.
storage_policy: Store all matched pre-holdout observations once with eligibility flags; expose EligiblePrices as a view. Retain warm-up rows only for trailing features and apply eligibility on the decision date before panel selection.
